The Styling System

This page explains how CSS is organized in a SAX project: theme tokens, the division of labor among the section style files, and the fixed order in which they are concatenated into a single app.css. All class names and the order are taken from the actual contents of D:\projects\sla\codex_ui.

General Principles

  • All styling uses global CSS classes, referenced in SAX via className; there is no CSS-in-JS and no local scoping.
  • The Mui*-* utility classes emitted by MUI library components also need appearance definitions — this baseline is hand-written as overrides in theme.css (such as .MuiButton-contained, .MuiChip-colorSuccess).
  • Source files are split into theme.css + styles/*.css; after a change they are re-concatenated in a fixed order into a single app.css, which is passed at build time with --css app.css.
  • Any newly introduced custom cxu-* class must be defined in theme.css or in one of the styles/*.css files (one of the consistency checks).

theme.css: Global Tokens (the official-black Palette)

:root declares --cxu-* tokens and sets color-scheme: dark. Core color values:

TokenValueUse
--cxu-bg#070a0ePage background (the official-black base color)
--cxu-primary#61f3f3Primary color (cyan highlight)
--cxu-secondary#ffab00Secondary accent color (amber)
--cxu-paper / --cxu-paper-soft / --cxu-panel#10161d / #151d26 / #0d1319Backgrounds for cards, soft panels, and input panels
--cxu-text / --cxu-muted#f9fafb / #a8b3bfBody text / muted text
--cxu-linergba(255,255,255,0.09)Uniform outline
--cxu-success / --cxu-error / --cxu-info / --cxu-violet#4ade80 / #f87171 / #38bdf8 / #a78bfaSemantic colors
--cxu-radius / --cxu-mono10px / JetBrains Mono stackCorner radius / monospace font

The same file also contains three more parts: the MUI generated-class baseline (.MuiPaper-root, buttons/inputs/Chip/Table/Switch/Dialog, etc.), shared layout primitives (cxu-row / cxu-grow / cxu-caption / cxu-pill / cxu-scroll / cxu-mono / cxu-icon / cxu-primary-link), and the development navigation bar cxu-devnav plus the global hiding class cxu-hidden (display:none !important, the basis for mutually exclusive screen display).

styles/*.css: Division of Labor and Concatenation Order

#Source fileCoverage
1theme.cssGlobal tokens, MUI baseline, shared primitives, devnav
2styles/shell.cssScreen layouts for WorkbenchScreen / ChatGptShellScreen / SettingsDrawerScreen / SetupGuideScreen
3styles/workbench_regions.cssWorkbench regions: TopBar+TaskTabStrip / HistorySidebarPanel / ChatWaterfallPanel / AgentOverviewGridPanel
4styles/dialogs.cssDialogs: FreeModelAccessDialog / OfficialOpenAiLoginDialog / AgentRosterManagerDialog
5styles/panels.cssPanels: ComposerDock / RightWorkspacePanelPanel / SideChatPanelPanel / WorkspaceExplorerPanelPanel
6styles/admin.cssAdmin pages: MembersPermissionsScreen / SecuritySettingsScreen / UsageBillingScreen
7styles/plugins.cssPluginSettingsScreen / LaunchAdaptersScreen / ProjectGroupChatDialog
8styles/settings_tabs1.cssSettings sections: Appearance / Layout / Notifications
9styles/settings_tabs2.cssSettings sections: Assistant / Codex / Workspace / Session
10styles/settings_tabs3.cssSettings sections: Relay / Launch / Skills
11styles/settings_tabs4.cssSettings sections: Pet / Privacy / About
12styles/gates.cssShared gate skeleton (cxu-gate*) / CliPrerequisiteScreen / LegalConsentScreen / LoginScreen

Run the following command in the project root directory to re-concatenate (the order must match the table above):

cat theme.css styles/shell.css styles/workbench_regions.css styles/dialogs.css \
    styles/panels.css styles/admin.css styles/plugins.css \
    styles/settings_tabs1.css styles/settings_tabs2.css styles/settings_tabs3.css \
    styles/settings_tabs4.css styles/gates.css > app.css

Conditional Class Names in SAX Files

State-driven style switching does not use JS; instead it builds class names with brace templates in the attribute position, combined with cxu-hidden or active-state classes:

<section className="cxu-screen{nav_settings ? '' : ' cxu-hidden'}">…</section>

<button className="MuiButton-root cxu-theme-card{th_black ? ' cxu-theme-selected' : ''}"
        onClick={pick_th_black}>…</button>
NoteThis “brace template embedded in a quoted value” is legal syntax explicitly supported by the react compilation pipeline; ternaries in the text position, by contrast, are not allowed (see SAX Syntax Rules).
